svg.title: मुहर — the full chakra seal, round Ø50mm, single ink
svg.desc: Rubber-stamp artwork at true size Ø50mm: the complete rta-chakra (petals, windows, rim, hub) in the thickened stamp edition, ringed by ऋतम्भरेश्वर मंदिर above and पहाड़ीखेड़ा · जबलपुर below. Single ink, violet pad. Never mails.
